evals.prompt: Fix this Bash job: set -e; mycall(); rc=$?; echo done. Preserve fail-closed behavior; mycall has several commands.
evals.expected_output: Returns a target-specific result with checkable evidence and explicit unverified boundaries.
expectations: Removes the malformed mycall() invocation syntax.
Does not rely on unreachable rc=$? after an unguarded failure under errexit.
Uses explicit status returns for critical steps inside functions called in conditional contexts.
Does not disable errexit globally or continue after the critical failure.
